_comment: Ticket links that must never be published, even when telonticket.cl lists the show. Each entry is matched as a SUBSTRING against both the telonticket obra URL and the vendor URL; a match means the obra is treated as having no tickets. Used by scripts/update-tickets.js (when writing tickets.json) and scripts/ensure-tickets.js (prunes an already-written tickets.json before every build).

blocked.reason: Montaje del Teatro Nescafe de las Artes; la resena es del montaje de Colectivo CTM.
